articles.summary: ("WhiteHorse Finance" or the "Company") (Nasdaq: WHF) today announced its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. In addition, the Company's board of directors has declared a distribution of $0.25 per share with respect to the quarter ending December 31, 2026. The distribution will be payable on January 6, 2027 to stockholders of record as of December 21, 2026. Stuart Aronson, WhiteHorse Finance's Chief Executive Officer, commented, "During the third quarter, we continued to execute on the priorities we have previously outlined, including actively managing restructured and underperforming credits and maintaining discipline in new originations. Net asset value per share increased for a second consecutive quarter, driven by favorable portfolio markups. Non-accruals declined following the completion of a restructuring, and there were no new additions to non-accrual during the quarter.
